context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Classes module (Clases en Vivo) fully functional. Teacher routes: /teacher/live-classes, Student routes: /student/live-classes. Both sidebars have 'Clases en Vivo' nav item with Video icon. Status computed dynamically based on Peru timezone (UTC-5). Join button available 10 min before class start. MongoDB collections: 'live_classes', 'live_class_attendance'.

backend_endpoints.POST /api/live-classes: Create live class (teacher only, validates assignment, sanitizes link)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/live-classes: List classes by role (teacher sees own, student sees section)
backend_endpoints.DELETE /api/live-classes/{id}: Delete class + attendance records (teacher owner only)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/live-classes/{id}/attendance: Get attendance list with student names
